answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the copper of a task receipt, and the atlas is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
